claim_summary: The exact Euclidean inradius and complete set of largest-inscribed-ball centers have a unique algebraic transition; the inradius-maximizing member differs from the established volume maximizer.
integrity: The 2026 nine-vertex maximum-volume theorem and its optimizer coordinates are credited to Hoehner and Ledford. The elementary convex-symmetry method is not presented as new. Source dates are earliest verified arXiv submissions.
limitations: Only the stated symmetric one-parameter family is optimized for inradius. No claim about arbitrary nine-vertex configurations or asymmetric triaugmented prisms. Historical priority is provisional and independent verification has not been performed.
object: Nine vertices on the unit sphere with three equatorial vertices and two rotated equilateral triangles at opposite heights, indexed by 1/2<r<1.
title: An eight-facet insphere transition in symmetric triaugmented triangular prisms
